reviews.review_msg: JF is kind, caring, & enthusiastic. It's clear they put effort into the lectures & pre-recorded videos. Grading is strict but fair. Follow the rubric and ask for help in office hours if needed. They are open to all questions. Since RISK 360W has two profs, I think JF's presence wasn't really felt until the last 3-4 weeks. Wish we got more of them.

JF is a very organized professor, and that usually makes a student's life much easier. His expectations for both the project and the exams are communicated very clearly throughout the course. The content can feel long and dense, so I recommend starting your studying early to avoid falling behind. He also provides constructive and helpful feedback.
Extremely difficult subject, though he tries to make it as accessible as it can get. Still very math heavy and lots of homework, and challenging and long projects.
Great teacher, makes actuarial science as fun as it can be. Take his courses, he is a very caring teacher.
